references.text: Describes the responsibility of Merari's sons for the tabernacle's boards, bars, pillars, and sockets—the same task mentioned in Num 4:33
The immediately preceding text detailing the specific duties and equipment that Merari's sons were to carry
Merari's sons were given four carts and eight oxen to transport the heavy parts of the tabernacle, under Ithamar's supervision
Gershon's and Merari's sons carried the tabernacle when the camp broke up, as described in their service duties
Ithamar is mentioned as a son of Aaron the priest, the same person who had oversight over Merari's sons
Ithamar had supervision over the Levites' work at the tabernacle, corresponding to his role regarding Merari's sons
The service of Gershon's sons was also under Ithamar's leadership, showing his supervisory role over multiple Levite families
